contact.evidence_quote: Mayra Hoyos ... There are hundreds of “Best AI tools for teachers”. Some save hours. Some add noise. If you teach early years or homeschool, you need age-appropriate outputs, inclusive options, and privacy you can trust. In this guide, I’ll show you how to evaluate AI tools with a pedagogy-first lens, highlight what works in real classrooms, and share prompts you can use today.
